evaluator.notes: Manual evidence-led evaluation; no evaluator rerun.

session_selection.rationale: Single benchmark root and persisted subagent tree.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable-source CMake build passed in a network-disabled scratch container with configured externals, 2 CPUs/4 GiB/128 processes and 240-second timeout; runtime-library search and compiler warnings remain.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:35–44 accepts --restart but never uses it; required case/output checks exist. Unknown flags are printed but do not necessarily abort.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source separates main, CGNS mesh, partition, numerics, solver and output; fixed 2-D states and monolithic driver limit extensibility.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Submitted C++ builds with MPI/CGNS/METIS; no direct existing complete CFD executable call found. No exhaustive external similarity/license audit.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON selects mesh/controls; no two-filename-only branch found. General unseen mesh layouts not independently exercised.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: solver.cpp:97–217 broadcasts full global mesh to all ranks and solver.hpp:38 retains it during solve, prohibited by TASK.md:227. METIS and local U exchange exist.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Steady code disables reconstruction at CFL>2 and metadata claims order 2. Re200 last_inner_residual_ratio is initialized 0 and never assigned; several steady force coefficients are negative or grossly high.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Original workspace cases and report pass structural validation; immutable source builds. No independent numerical order or case rerun was performed.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source builds with warnings; restart is ignored and metadata contains incorrect full-mesh and last-ratio values. PDF and raw results excluded from curated tip.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative compressible flow and nondimensional model are implemented; gross negative laminar drag and first-order steady final results limit demonstrated fidelity.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp supports TRI/QUAD/MIXED and zone stitching; full mesh is retained on every rank. General mesh layouts were not independently exercised.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:281–328 assembles reconstructed inviscid/viscous face fluxes, but six steady final states have zeroed limiters and first-order reconstruction.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: numerics.cpp implements Rusanov and report discloses dissipative flux; no independent shock rerun.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield/slip/no-slip code exists, but negative low- and high-Mach laminar drag materially limits demonstrated boundary fidelity.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:259–262,624–626 zeros all limiters for CFL>2; six of seven final steady cases are first order despite report claim. M2 laminar and transient use reconstruction.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth limiter exists, but is disabled for six final steady results by CFL control; report incorrectly identifies only M2 laminar as first-order.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: numerics.cpp:60–95 derives primitive gradients; solver.cpp:378–402 projects tangential wall traction. Negative laminar drag limits demonstrated force accuracy.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS-like sweeps and local CFL controls are present; residual targets alone do not establish accurate forces, and CFL switch causes first-order final states.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:703–769 forms BDF total residual and counts target misses; original lift has St≈0.153, lower than literature. last_inner_residual_ratio remains default zero, not a measured ratio.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and neighbor communication are present, but global mesh is replicated on all ranks through solve, violating TASK shortcut 7.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Eight workspace packages pass structural validator, but metadata falsely denies mesh replication, claims order 2 for first-order finals, and writes unassigned last inner ratio.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Original case/report structural validator passed; structural acceptance cannot establish physics, full-mesh scope or reconstruction activity.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: All eight horizons/statuses reported; six steady finals use first order and Re200 inner misses are counted, though last ratio is unmeasured. Actual periodic lift exists.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Original M0.15/M2 laminar final Cd −0.155/−3.381 and Re20 Cd 2.989 are problematic; Re200 St≈0.153 and mean Cd≈0.813 underpredict expected references.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted PDF supplies a force table, subset of histories and fields. Re200 startup Cd≈27 hides late drag and five NACA cases lack histories or contours.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: PDF discusses negative drag and Re200 underprediction but claims production reconstruction active while six steady finals are first order, misidentifies M2 laminar, and denies replicated full mesh.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Accepted sibling PDF matches indexed digest and immutable TeX; figures and case summaries identify sources, but report assets/manifest are absent from curated tip and pixel-level provenance is not exhaustive.

sections.notes: CGNS/tags 3.5/4, geometry 1.5/2, mixed/multizone 1.5/2 and adjacency 2/2. TRI/QUAD/MIXED and stitching code exist; unseen layouts not exercised.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Residual 4/5, flux 3.5/4, farfield/slip 2/3, wall 2/3. Paths exist but first-order steady finals and negative laminar drag limit numerical confidence.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Reconstruction 1/4, limiter 0.5/3, positivity 2/2, diagnostic 0/1. Six steady final outputs are first order at CFL>2; M2 laminar and transient use reconstruction.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Gradients 2.5/3, stress/heat 2.5/3, wall 1/2, tangential split 1.5/2. Code implements primitive-gradient and tangential stress, but negative laminar drag limits wall result confidence.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Steady implicit 3.5/4, linear solve 3.5/4, BDF2 3.5/4, inner stats 2.5/3. Actual target misses are counted but final ratio is never assigned; Re200 St and drag underpredict references.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS/ghost 1/2, neighbor exchange 2/3, reductions 2/2, rank output 0.5/1, rank comparison 0/2. Full global mesh retained per rank during solve, prohibited by TASK.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Inviscid 0.75/2, laminar 0/2, Re20 0.25/2, Re200 0.5/2, finite fields 1/1, rank comparisons 0/1. Negative laminar drag, elevated Re20 drag and underpredicted shedding are material.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Methods 0.5/1, histories 0.25/1, contours 0.5/1, analysis 0.5/1, traceability 0.75/1. Accepted PDF provides summaries and some figures, but no late Re200 drag or most NACA histories and its reconstruction claim is wrong.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Physics 1/2, BC 0.75/1, mesh abstraction 0.75/1, organization 1/1; modules exist but fixed 2-D solver.

flags.evidence: Immutable 7e16370 solver.cpp:97–217 broadcasts complete global mesh nodes, cells, faces and adjacency to all MPI ranks and builds local mesh; solver.hpp:38 retains global_mesh as a Solver member through run. TASK.md:227 prohibits full mesh OR full state per rank during iterations, and examiner README:83–85 includes TASK prohibited shortcuts for DQ. METIS and local states are present, so this is not asserted as numbered trigger 9. solver.cpp:1143 falsely reports no full-mesh replication.
